failure_summary.description: Agents returned an associated event or location, or judged a clue true, instead of identifying the requested bomb, person, or play.
Agents failed to resolve the full compressed clue or its context, choosing a salient association over the intended wordplay, relation, or conventional completion.
Answers used a nickname instead of the supported full name or added a modifier beyond the expected headword.

patch.reasoning: The most repeated errors are already covered by the existing semantic-type and pronoun rules, but were not followed. The remaining context/clue-resolution and answer-form issues overlap with similar additions rejected in earlier steps, so no nonduplicative edit is warranted.
